propositions: Natural fold operations retire orphan event files and cite their uuids in source_event_uuids without applying their effects, causing repairable race damage to become permanently silent loss.

The fold's whole-directory enumeration and replay positional skip mechanism destroys orphan event evidence; fsck then reports clean instead of ORPHAN_EVENT because the uuid is now cited and file retired.
Orphan events remain repairable only before the next natural fold crosses the compaction threshold; after that fold the damage becomes unrepairable by tooling.
The fold must exclude fsck-classified orphans (un-cited pre-snapshot events) from both retirement and source_event_uuids citation, anchored to the latest prior snapshot in the fold set.
The shared orphan predicate (is_snapshot_orphan) must be extracted and reused between compact_txn and fsck so fold and fsck cannot disagree on orphan classification.
